dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Presence of a thick, high-contrast white band across the wing coverts, showing maximum grayscale contrast against the dark gray flight feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Folded flight feathers exhibit sharp, high-contrast pale edges along the primary and secondary margins against dark feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A broad, rectangular high-contrast white patch is visible on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Highly distinct, linear demarcation formed by the white nape patch separating the mottled brown crown from the solid gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white crescent-shaped patch located at the base of the wing near the scapulars.
